programs.title: Father Brown
programs.desc: The author of the erotic novel "Lulu and Lucia", Lucia Morell, is murdered with an axe.The perpetrator took the writer's severed hand from the crime scene.Father Brown has suspicions that the killer did not want the identity of the second heroine of Morell's prose to be revealed and the answer to who the murderer is hidden in the book.The suspects include Lady Ursula Lansford, who runs a shelter for former prisoners, her son, who was repeatedly humiliated by the writer, as well as the gardener and two charges of the Lansford house.Soon, a gruesome discovery is made in Ursula's bathroom.

programs.title: Keeping up Appearances 2
programs.desc: Jacynta Bukiet (Patricia Routledge), a pretentious middle-aged woman, wants to be considered a classy woman who only moves in high circles.He does not admit his origins and is ashamed of his poor sisters - Róża and Stokrotka.She plays the lady to her calm and well-behaved neighbor Elizabeth (Josephine Tewson) and her brother Emmet (David Griffin).This leads to many comic situations.Jacinta's husband, Richard (Clive Swift), is embarrassed by his wife's behavior, but for peace of mind he puts up with all the strangeness.

programs.title: Here We Go
programs.desc: The series presents the crazy fate of the Jessop family.The everyday life of this family is full of mishaps, misunderstandings and surprising twists.The events are presented from the point of view of Sam - a teenager who almost never leaves his camera and meticulously records his domestic adventures.Each episode brings new problems: failed holidays, risky business ideas, kidnapping of the neighbor's dog, destroyed swimming pool, family quarrels and even an interrupted wedding.Situational humor and brilliant dialogues make it easy to recognize your own family in these imperfect heroes.
